title: A filter table on the group-by column limits the groups
query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS ( Product[Color], TREATAS ( { "Red", "Green" }, Product[Color] ), "Amt", [Sales Amount] )

source.quote: A table expression which is added to the filter context of all columns specified as groupBy_columnName arguments.
source.supports: the filter applies to the group-by column and to the expression

source.quote: If all expressions evaluate to BLANK for a row, that row is not included in the table returned.

derivation: The filter keeps Red and Green. Red sales: 100 + 40 + 20 + 200 + 100 = 460. Green has none, so its row is dropped. Blue is filtered out.
